about: Owner rules as code: each rule names the checks that enforce it and a violation fixture each check must fail on. check:rules (scripts/check-rules.mjs) enforces this file.

owner_words.quote: every page = frame + sections; Publisher never writes or designs

rules.note: Static class checks over the Studio app and Publisher page records; the hand-built StudioPage.tsx branches the audit found are W1/W2 fix units.

owner_words.quote: all views use Designer's shadcn components only

rules.note: The ds-only vitest (producer test) covers sections, frames, renderers and component-layer frames, and is red on this tree in 4 tests that need a Designer-skill change: studio-slot-groups imports ../studio-specimen, which its owner-picked pin (studio-slot-groups-v4) does not declare in meta.element.deps.elements (a re-pin); and raw styled markup in the component-layer frames foundry/layout.tsx, foundry/block-viewer-iframe.tsx and foundry/studio-frames.tsx.

owner_words.quote: stock shadcn unmodified, tokens to shadcn vars

rules.note: Code-level gate: every pinned Designer candidate ships the vendored reference file plus only allowed hunks; an npm candidate ships only named re-exports of the package version package-lock.json resolves, and any other file it ships is that package's own file byte for byte.

owner_words.quote: DS exclusively shadcn plus trusted free registries

rules.note: Record-level gate: lineage must name a trusted manifest item; scans Foundry packages, not the consumer pins (consumer pins are R-SHADCN-STOCK).

owner_words.quote: visual to Designer, copy to Writer, assembly only to Publisher

fixture_runs.expect: ^names\s+writer slot strings\.unnamed: no Writer name for writer\.item\.strings\.unnamed

rules.note: Every string a person sees in Studio is Writer copy or registry data. check:copy-source fails on JSX text or a literal copy attribute (aria-*, title, placeholder, alt, label) or copy property in Studio, Designer Studio frames and the server rows; a literal label, prompt, title, message or tree name in a pinned Publisher record; an id turned into a label outside src/records/slot-labels.ts; a slot or IA node, group or layer with no pinned strings.names record; a Writer key no pinned record holds; Studio reading a thrown or served .message/.error (so Producer JSON errors never render); and a literal <html lang>. check-copy-rendered opens every route Publisher installed in one built Studio and fails on any rendered text, copy attribute, title or meta description that is neither pinned Writer text (ICU templates matched) nor pinned registry data, and on an <html lang> that is not the Writer source locale. The fixture breaks each rule once.

owner_words.quote: consumer owns nav and routing data per publication

rules.note: Nav, commands and breadcrumbs must be Publisher projections of the pinned content map; the icon map overriding pins is a W-unit defect.

owner_words.quote: agents/<agent>/<slot-id>/ flat; grouping only in ia.json data

rules.note: No check fails when a legacy library/ or cells store is read or shipped (W3 CLI on flat slot folders); the selection.json store alone is refused by check:no-selection-store.

owner_words.quote: every L3 is a slot, candidates are files, one pinned

rules.note: slot-resolve no-pin/multi-pin runs only inside clossys check, never from root check (W4 pin schema).

owner_words.quote: Studio previews the consumer workspace in the consumer brand; never greyscale

rules.note: No check fails when consumer brand assets point at Foundry files or a theme failure falls back to the Foundry theme.

owner_words.quote: read-only Studio; the card shows active state and links to the L3 route

rules.note: Class checks for the slot card and detail template; the read-only 405 API is covered by producer src tests.

owner_words.quote: Studio previews what cells produce, not file text

rules.note: No check fails when a slot detail falls back to a raw candidate-file-text table.

owner_words.quote: all layers link uses and used-by; DOM provenance

rules.note: usage-graph --check is freshness only; nothing compares slot.json uses with candidate imports or checks DOM provenance ids.

owner_words.quote: clossys verbs = brief, check, compile only

rules.note: No check runs the CLI verbs against the real consumer store, where they exit 2 (W3).

owner_words.quote: rules must become code, not prose

rules.note: Every check file is reachable from root check or test, and every rule has a check that fails on its fixture.

owner_words.quote: no temp solutions; delete shims, never extend

rules.note: No class check fails on a silent fallback (theme catch, unknown icon, newest-draft preview); only per-feature tests exist.

owner_words.quote: shadcn item, else a composition of pinned parts, else mark unneeded

rules.note: Every L3 slot is pinned or marked not-needed: check-slot-state lands with W4 and is not on this base.

owner_words.quote: the rendering itself is just the same deterministic plumbing that works everytime without llm token spend

rules.note: compile reads only ia.json, the content map, pins and pinned candidate files, offline, byte-identical across runs; the check is built on claude/compile-pure.

owner_words.quote: process driven by code and identifiers so that we decide which candidate goes in which slot

rules.note: Slot decisions (pin, not-needed) are written only by the clossys pin CLI; check:decisions fails on any hand-edited decision record (pin shape, candidate, hash, both, not-needed shape).

owner_words.quote: ok clean up and harden

fixture_runs.expect: FAIL pin-attribution designer/components\.button/pin\.json: pin has no basis

rules.note: Agent trees under clossys/agents/<agent>/ hold only ia.json and slot folders; a slot folder holds only slot.json, candidates/ and pin.json, matches ia.json, has a candidate, and a pin names an existing candidate by exact sha256 with decidedBy and basis (picked | bulk | planner). Evidence lives in clossys/evidence/. No agent is exempt.

owner_words.quote: add some variety to the candidate generation so end user have a choice

rules.note: Every Director and Writer slot is classed by the committed option-class mapping (records/slot-model/option-classes.ts); its slot.json options and varyOn match its class, and a choice slot holds at least that many candidates that differ on varyOn, each tagged with a distinct allowed value. An agent seat's pick (clossys pick --by agent:<seat>, basis agent) may replace a bulk, planner or agent pin, never an owner pick. The fixture is a three-option slot holding one untagged candidate.

owner_words.quote: anything that is deterministic need to be process driven by code and identifiers

fixture_runs.expect: ^FAIL decide\.foreign-writer: workspace\.config \(decide\) owns clossys/clossys\.config\.ts, but scripts/rules/fixtures/R-PIPELINE-IS-CODE/repo-write/write-workspace-config\.mjs can write it
^FAIL lane\.unrostered: step "auditor\.candidates": its holder auditor .* is not a roster entry
^FAIL stage\.orphan: step "capture" \(publish\.check\): no derived edge feeds it

rules.note: Every pipeline step is a defineStep call; check:pipeline fails when a decide step's output can be written inside the repository by code outside its declared entry (a write that resolves outside the repository root, such as a scratch copy under os.tmpdir(), is not a repository write). Every step names a stage from define.ts STAGES (stage.missing) and a holder that is a roster.ts ROSTER entry (lane.unrostered), and every step outside the first stage (direct.brief, the Direct round's brief) is fed by a derived edge (stage.orphan: only a direct.brief step may start the flow); the stage-missing, lane-unrostered and stage-orphan fixtures are the real steps with one stage removed, one step held by an unrostered agent and the capture step stripped of its inputs.

owner_words.quote: anything that is deterministic need to be process driven by code and identifiers

fixture_runs.expect: ^FAIL edge-ids: edge missing from the page: design\.hero->publish\.compile
^FAIL contain: the badge of step design\.hero .* overflows its node
^FAIL stage: step publish\.compile is outside the publish stage column
^FAIL roster: graph\.json lanes \(designer, publisher\) are not the roster
^FAIL flow: edge design\.hero->design\.card inside the make stage does not run left to right
^FAIL rank: in the make stage, step design\.hero \(rank 0\) is not left of design\.card \(rank 1\)
^FAIL orphan: step publish\.compile \(publish\) has no edge into it
^FAIL flow: edge designer\.candidates->ia runs backward: designer\.candidates \(design\.make\) feeds ia \(direct\.brief\)
^FAIL stage: stage design\.make's header is outside the design round

rules.note: The Studio Content overview (/content) draws graph.json only: check:pipeline-canvas renders it headless in the installed Chrome and fails unless the drawn node ids equal the step ids and the drawn edge ids equal the graph edges (from->to), with React Flow's pinned stylesheet and the generated --xy-* theme applied, no two node boxes (steps and lane labels) intersecting at the initial view in 1440x900, one label per lane, every step inside its lane's swim row and its stage's column (one header per stage, and, when the stages are grouped in rounds, one header per round above and spanning its stages' headers), the drawn lane rows equal to graph.json's roster (plus unassigned while a step has no holder), every edge flowing forward (never into an earlier stage in (round, stage) order, and left to right inside one stage), ranks left to right inside each stage column, every step outside the first stage fed by an edge, every step title at 12px or more on screen at the initial view, the canvas filling the window's remaining height, the legend inside the viewport, every step's kind badge and title inside its node box, and (in the browser) a click on a step node or Enter on the focused step opening its sheet. The fixtures are recorded renderings: one drops an edge, one draws a kind badge past its node's right edge, one draws a step outside its stage column, one draws lanes that leave out a roster entry, one has an edge back into an earlier stage, one draws a rank-1 step left of the rank-0 step that feeds it in one stage, one has a later-stage step no edge feeds, one has an edge from the design round back into the direct round, and one draws a stage header outside its round.

owner_words.quote: make sure all pages/routes are built via publisher itself officially

rules.note: Every Studio route, nav link, command, breadcrumb, tab, landing and redirect target comes from the Publisher projection (studio/generated/studio-map.json): check:routes-published fails on an installed app/**/page.tsx that mounts no published page record or sits off its record's path, a leaf template slug that is no published leaf, a published record or leaf set with no installed route, any link to a path that is no published page or leaf, and breadcrumbs, tabs or landings missing from the projection. The fixture serves an unpublished probe route, leaves an orphan record unserved and links a breadcrumb to an unpublished path.

owner_words.quote: i want a super tight/connect system, so that we have all the plumbing/wiring locked

fixture_runs.expect: leak\.mjs:\d+: readFileSync opens a slot-model path outside the reader

rules.note: Shipped code opens the slot model (ia.json, slot.json, pin.json, candidates) only through packages/producer/src/records/slots.ts and writes it only through records/slot-write.ts. The fixture is a package source file that reads a Designer pin.json by hand.

owner_words.quote: i want a super tight/connect system, so that we have all the plumbing/wiring locked

fixture_runs.run: cp -R {fixture}/repo {out}/repo && mkdir -p {out}/repo/packages/producer {out}/repo/packages/publisher && cp {fixture}/built/stub.mjs {out}/repo/packages/stub.mjs && cp -R {fixture}/built/producer {out}/repo/packages/producer/dist && cp -R {fixture}/built/publisher {out}/repo/packages/publisher/dist && CLOSSYS_CHECK_REPO={out}/repo node --test packages/producer/scripts/check-pin-propagation.test.mjs
fixture_runs.expect: drift: Studio detail flags the pin hash mismatch

rules.note: A pin is the one wire from a slot to everything that renders it: drifting a pinned candidate byte is flagged by Studio detail and refused by the page and specimen builds, and a repin changes Studio, the specimen inputs and Publisher output. The fixture is a built surface (stub modules over a two-slot model) whose Studio slot detail never compares the pin sha256 with the candidate bytes; with that defect removed the same fixture passes.

owner_words.quote: i want a super tight/connect system, so that we have all the plumbing/wiring locked

fixture_runs.run: cp -R {fixture}/repo {out}/repo && mkdir -p {out}/repo/packages/producer {out}/repo/packages/publisher && cp {fixture}/built/stub.mjs {out}/repo/packages/stub.mjs && cp -R {fixture}/built/producer {out}/repo/packages/producer/dist && cp -R {fixture}/built/publisher {out}/repo/packages/publisher/dist && CLOSSYS_CHECK_REPO={out}/repo node --test packages/producer/scripts/check-every-candidate-previewable.test.mjs
fixture_runs.expect: the specimen route does not accept this \(slot, candidate\)

rules.note: Every placed, valid candidate renders from its own bytes and only the valid pin is used by pages: an unpinned Designer candidate is a specimen option the route accepts. The fixture is a built surface (stub modules over a two-slot model) whose specimen inputs list no options; with that defect removed the same fixture passes.
